title: Arithmetic Siegel-Weil for the spherical Hecke algebra
summary: We formulate a conjectural generalization of the arithmetic Siegel-Weil formula, relating intersection multiplicities of cycles on unitary Rapoport-Zink spaces to central derivatives of local Whittaker functions. The new aspect of the conjecture is that it incorporates the action of certain Hecke correspondences on the Rapoport-Zink space. We verify the conjecture in a low-dimensional case.
